description: Temporal delegation replay: a prior delegation record is replayed such that its temporal relationship to the current task acceptance is invalid — TASK_ACCEPT.timestamp < DELEGATE.timestamp (acceptance precedes the delegation that authorizes it).

rule.name: INV-02_temporal_replay
rule.description: A delegation establishing authority must precede acceptance or exercise of that authority (no replay)

action.reason: temporally inconsistent delegation: task acceptance precedes the delegation that authorizes it (INV-02)
